نتبايع (form VI)
# نَتَبَايَعُ (natabāyaʕu) /na.ta.baː.ja.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَبَايَعَ (tabāyaʕa)
# نَتَبَايَعَ (natabāyaʕa) /na.ta.baː.ja.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَبَايَعَ (tabāyaʕa)
# نَتَبَايَعْ (natabāyaʕ) /na.ta.baː.jaʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَبَايَعَ (tabāyaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
